text:
A person is speaking. The sound the person makes can be transmitted as a signal rather than as
a longitudinal wave.
Which statement about the transmission of the sound as a signal is correct?
A
The sound is originally analogue but can be transmitted as a digital signal.
B
The sound is originally digital but can be transmitted as an analogue signal.
C
The sound is originally analogue and can only be transmitted as an analogue signal.
D
The sound is originally digital and can only be transmitted as a digital signal.

options.label: A
options.text: The sound is originally analogue but can be transmitted as a digital signal.

options.label: B
options.text: The sound is originally digital but can be transmitted as an analogue signal.

options.label: C
options.text: The sound is originally analogue and can only be transmitted as an analogue signal.

options.label: D
options.text: The sound is originally digital and can only be transmitted as a digital signal.

subject: Physics
